contentText:
Victoria Song / The Verge :

Meta Fury, Meta Adventurer, and Meta Glasses by Kylie have EssilorLuxottica stamped on the inside; Meta executives say dropping “Ray-Ban” helps lower the price   —  For the past three years, “Meta” and “Ray-Ban” have been synonymous in the smart glasses space.  Not anymore.
